tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registered Certificate and License under Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
Trade License Certificate issued by Health Department (Animal Husbandry Section)/ any urban local bodies/municipality.
Business license letter from the concerned bodies like Metropolitan Corporation, Municipal Council, Municipality, Gram Panchayat etc. and the said license should be renewed for the current year.
Zoo contractor registration certificate. (Any one of the Zoos under ZAK)
Uploading a satisfactory certificate from the relevant organizations regarding the satisfactory supply of food materials to any Zoo, Central / State Government Institutions.
Previous 3 years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) GST returns and challan.

Previous 3 years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25) annual trading documents, balance sheet and financial stability confirmation and audit by charted accountant audit report and turn over details. (Minimum 50 lakhs turnover in last 3 years)
Previous 3 years (2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25)Income tax returns file records.
Affidavit in Rs.100 bond paper regarding not listed in block list
Unit no. 02 Participant in meat supply tender to upload license letter obtained from authorized organization/department to run slaughter house. (Slaughter house certified issued by municipality)
